description: Road Lengths & Lighting Poles is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This Dataset contains information about road lengths and light poles for 2017-2018. Data from Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affair. Export API data for more datasets to advance energy economics research. We have used year converter to find the Gregorian year Historical data is available in an old dataset. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Roads, Light Poles. The portal shows 2023-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
